Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
QueueUpdatable, Serializable
public class Game extends Object implements Serializable, QueueUpdatable
The Game class is the core model and controller of the application logic. It encapsulates the entire state of a single match, managing players, the cardboard, the track, and the event system. It utilizes a State Machine pattern to drive the gameLoop, ensuring that rules and phases are strictly enforced. All player interactions are securely synchronized using a shared Locks object to handle asynchronous network requests safely.

      public Game(int numOfPlayers, List<String> playersNicknames, String roomName)
      Constructs a new Game instance and initializes the first state. Handled by the Initial Setup phase to accommodate 2 to 5 players.
      Parameters:
      numOfPlayers - the total number of participants.
      playersNicknames - the list of player nicknames.
      roomName - the name of the hosting room.

  • Method Details

    • gameLoop

      public void gameLoop()
      The main execution thread of the game. It broadcasts the initial mockup, then continuously executes the current state until the state machine returns null (game over).
